verdict.rationale: LM Studio runs entirely on-device with all inference, chat, RAG, and voice data processed locally and never leaving the machine (lm-studio-docs-32, lm-studio-docs-7), which inherently gives the user full control over where data resides—their own device. However, there is no evidence of a formal 'region/residency' selection feature (e.g., choosing among cloud data-center regions) since LM Studio has no cloud storage layer at all; residency is a byproduct of the local-first architecture rather than an explicit configurable choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or docs, any cloud storage option with region choice, and independent confirmation of data-location guarantees beyond marketing copy.
